race.comment: DREAM FOR FREE (2) showed a stack of pace on debut but couldn't keep going and finished sixth over today's course and distance 16 days ago. Should progress with that run under the belt and against an ordinary field today he looks well-placed to open his account. RED RABBIT (12) returns after a five-month break. Raced twice last prep and did nothing but did display some talent at the previous campaign. Won a recent Avoca jump-out which is a good sign going forward. ENNISCRONE (3) has failed twice recently in 1200m races against better company. Competitive prior to that in the 1000-1100m range. In the right race to bounce back to form. SAMMIE ELLEN BOY (8) recorded his first placing last start when third in a moderate maiden at Mildura over this distance. Open to further improvement and is an each-way hope. WAVENDON (9) last raced in January. Finished a close fourth first-up last prep over 1200m at Naracoorte. In the mix.
